brand.name: FIRST MILANO
brand.subtitle: Private Chauffeur Service
brand.positioning: High-end European private chauffeur and NCC service in Milan with optional personal security integration.

theme.style: Contemporary High-End European Luxury Chauffeur (Maison de Lysenne / Monaco Royal Limousines visual tier)

display_font.name: Cormorant Garamond / Cinzel / Playfair Display
display_font.usage: Main Brand Logo, Hero Headings, Section Titles, Numbered Manifesto Titles

body_font.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
body_font.usage: Body narrative, service descriptions, menu links, buttons, form controls, specs

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-serif uppercase
scale.eyebrow: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#D4AF37] font-sans font-semibold

layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (sharp luxury aesthetic, max 4px for elements)

motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Lenis momentum smooth scroll mandatory across page
motion_and_effects.scroll_reveal: Framer motion staggered opacity & translate-y (duration 0.7s, ease: [0.25, 1, 0.5, 1])
motion_and_effects.hero_reveal: Line-by-line masked kinetic text reveal on load
motion_and_effects.hover_states: Border transition to #D4AF37, slight dark lift, button fill expansion

sections_breakdown.title: Sticky Transforming Header
requirements: Position: fixed top-0 w-full z-50
Initial state: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0B0C0E]/70 border-b border-[#D4AF37]/10
Scrolled state: bg-[#0B0C0E]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#D4AF37]/30 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300
Left: Brand logo with serif font 'FIRST MILANO' and gold subtitle 'Private Chauffeur Service'
Center: Anchored links (Home, Servizi, Flotta, Transfer Aeroporti, NCC con Guardia, Chi Siamo, Contatti)
Right: Language Switcher (IT / EN toggle) + Gold CTA 'RICHIEDI PREVENTIVO'
Mobile: Sleek slide-over dark drawer menu with champagne gold accents
Crucial: Header MUST NEVER be fully transparent to preserve contrast!

sections_breakdown.title: Cinematic Milan Hero
requirements: Full height background image with dark linear gradient overlay (from-black/80 via-black/50 to-[#0B0C0E])
Eyebrow: 'NOLEGGIO CON CONDUCENTE A MILANO'
H1: 'FIRST MILANO — PRIVATE CHAUFFEUR SERVICE'
Tagline: 'Eleganza, puntualità e discrezione.'
Description paragraph emphasizing luxury transfer, airport service, business events in Milan & Italy
CTAs: Primary gold button ('RICHIEDI UN PREVENTIVO'), Secondary outline gold button with WhatsApp icon ('CONTATTACI SU WHATSAPP')
Bottom Bar: 4 feature pills with icons (Aeroporti Malpensa / Linate / Orio; Autisti Professionali; Disponibilità su prenotazione; Milano & Italia)

sections_breakdown.title: Servizi Premium (6 Cards Grid)
requirements: Grid of 6 interactive dark cards with subtle gold line hover effect
1. Transfer Aeroportuali (Malpensa, Linate, Orio al Serio, jet privati)
2. Business & Corporate (Meeting, roadshow, delegazioni aziendali)
3. Autista a Disposizione (Servizio orario su misura per shopping e impegni)
4. Eventi & Fashion Week (Milano Moda, Salone del Mobile, gala)
5. Viaggi & Lunghe Percorrenze (Trasferimenti in tutta Italia ed Europa)
6. NCC con Guardia del Corpo (Servizio combinato chauffeur + executive protection)

sections_breakdown.title: La Flotta (Luxury Mercedes Showcase)
requirements: Dark contrast section (#141619 background) showcasing 2 main luxury categories
Card 1: Berline di Lusso (Mercedes-Benz Classe S / Classe E) - Comfort supremo, privacy glass, Wi-Fi a bordo, acqua per gli ospiti
Card 2: Van di Lusso (Mercedes-Benz Classe V Extra Long) - Fino a 7 passeggeri, salotto di bordo, ampi bagagli, finiture in pelle
Interactive spec list (Passeggeri, Bagagli, Wi-Fi, Acqua, Sedili in pelle, POS a bordo)

sections_breakdown.title: Transfer Aeroportuali Dedicated Hub
requirements: Dedicated visual section for Milan airports: Milano Malpensa (MXP), Milano Linate (LIN), Bergamo Orio al Serio (BGY), Aviopista Jet Privati
Flight tracking system highlight: Monitoraggio voli in tempo reale e accoglienza al gate con cartello personalizzato
Direct CTA: 'RICHIEDI TRANSFER AEROPORTO'

sections_breakdown.title: NCC con Guardia del Corpo (Premium Protection Add-on)
requirements: Subtle, elegant dark presentation — NO aggressive security branding, strictly executive protection & discretion
Professional chauffeur/guard in dark tailored suit near luxury vehicle
Key points: Protezione discreta, personale qualificato, massima riservatezza per VIP, VIP transfer con scorta personalizzata
CTA: 'RICHIEDI INFORMAZIONI PROTEZIONE'

sections_breakdown.title: Perché FIRST MILANO (4 Chapter Manifesto)
requirements: Numbered chapter layout (01 Puntualità Impeccabile, 02 Massimo Controllo e Discrezione, 03 Standard Esecutivo e Comfort, 04 Servizio Su Misura 24/7)

sections_breakdown.title: Modulo Richiesta Preventivo (WhatsApp + Email dispatch)
requirements: Conversion engine form featuring fields: Nome e Cognome, Telefono / WhatsApp, Email, Indirizzo Partenza, Indirizzo Destinazione, Data e Ora, Passeggeri, Bagagli, Tipologia Servizio (Select), Note aggiuntive, Checkbox Privacy Policy
Submits to backend FastAPI endpoint + generates pre-filled WhatsApp link with full itinerary breakdown!
Sonner toast notification on submission success

sections_breakdown.title: Contatti & Sede Operativa
requirements: Operational headquarters in Milano
Phone / WhatsApp direct contact button
Email support link
Availability notice: Disponibile 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 su prenotazione

sections_breakdown.title: Floating WhatsApp Button
requirements: Fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40 button with WhatsApp brand color (#25D366) and glowing pulse effect

i18n.requirement: Complete bidirectional translation switcher state supporting all text content on the site

testing_and_accessibility.mandatory_data_testid: All interactive buttons, links, inputs, selects, cards, and language toggles MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-preventivo-button', data-testid='quote-form-submit', data-testid='lang-switcher-en').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure gold text on dark background meets WCAG contrast ratios.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact JSON structure and guidelines when building the React frontend.
Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling and Framer Motion reveals are properly initialized.
Never drop or omit data-testid attributes on any element.
Do not use transparent header; always use glassmorphism with dark background tint.
Keep Javascript file extension standard (.js / .jsx) as defined in the template.
